faq.q: How do I start using kasir.mu for free?
faq.a: Download kasir.mu and launch it — the free plan starts immediately, no signup required.

faq.q: Does kasir.mu work without internet?

faq.q: How do I activate my license key?

faq.q: Is kasir.mu cheap? How much does it cost?

faq.q: Does kasir.mu run on cheap Android tablets or phones?

faq.q: Is there a free POS app that works offline?

faq.q: Does kasir.mu accept QRIS?

qris.title: QRIS POS: Static + Dynamic QR on Every Plan
qris.description: Accept static (store sticker) and dynamic per-transaction QRIS on every kasir.mu plan, including Free. Automatic Midtrans settlement, no extra EDC.
qris.lede: Your customers already pay by QR — kasir.mu accepts both. Show a dynamic QR with the transaction amount, or use your store's static QR sticker. Both ship on every plan, including Free.
points: Dynamic QR: amount locked per transaction via Midtrans, settlement polled automatically
Static QR: use your store NMID sticker, reference recorded and reconciled for the receipt
No extra EDC: just the cashier screen or tablet
On every plan: Free, Plus, Pro, Premium, Enterprise
qris.howTitle: How to accept QRIS at the counter
how: Open the bill on the payment screen and choose QRIS
For dynamic: show the generated QR to the customer to scan
For static: show the store QR sticker, record the reference shown
The sale matches automatically when settlement lands — receipt ready to print

faq.q: Is QRIS available on the free plan?
faq.a: Yes. Static + dynamic QRIS ships on every kasir.mu plan, including Free forever.

faq.q: What is the difference between static and dynamic QRIS?
faq.a: Static uses one store QR sticker for every amount (cashier records a manual reference). Dynamic generates a fresh QR per transaction with a locked amount and automatic verification.

faq.q: Do I need an EDC or extra device?
faq.a: No. Just the cashier screen or tablet — the QR shows on screen, customers scan with any e-wallet or mobile banking app.

faq.q: What if the internet dies during a QRIS payment?
faq.a: The sale is recorded locally and reconciled when the connection returns — the counter is never blocked.

faq.q: Do I need an EDC machine or a bank contract?
faq.a: No extra terminal: QRIS runs from the cashier screen or a tablet. Dynamic QR codes are created per transaction through Midtrans, or you can display your shop's own QRIS sticker.

faq.q: How do I know the payment actually landed?
faq.a: A dynamic QR is polled until the settlement comes back, then matched to that sale. With a static QR you record the reference and the server reconciles it for the receipt.

benefits: No more stockouts or over-ordering — see what's moving.
QRIS at the counter without extra hardware.
Cloud backup so your data is never lost.
day: Scan as you go. Barcodes clear a full basket in one pass, and every item sold comes off stock automatically.
Refill the shelf and correct it in two steps: pick the product, pick the reason — restock, count correction, customer return, damaged, disposal, transfer — and enter the change.
Count the shelves on the night shift and file the corrections under that count, so a difference found next week is still explainable.
Close the shift, then read the Stock Report: stock, threshold, price, cost, margin and stock value per product, ready to print or export.

faq.q: Will I know before a product runs out?
faq.a: You set a low-stock threshold per product per location, with a Global fallback for everything else, and each one can be switched on or off. Products below the line are flagged for reordering.

faq.q: How do I move stock between the shop and the warehouse?
faq.a: As a recorded transfer: source, destination, quantity and dispatch time. It stays in transit until it arrives, late transit is flagged, and a transfer entered by mistake can be reversed to put the stock back.

faq.q: Can I receive supplier deliveries into stock?
faq.a: Yes. Keep your suppliers, raise a purchase order, and press Receive when the delivery arrives — the received quantities go into stock automatically.

faq.q: Do the shop and the warehouse share one stock number?
faq.a: Neither shares the other. Stock is tracked per product per location — a register or a warehouse — and each register serves from its assigned location, so both numbers stay separate and both stay visible.

benefits: Simple enough for a warung — no training needed.

day: Open the shift with the cash that is already in the drawer. The opening float is optional — enter it, and the evening count reconciles itself.
Sell in a few taps. Barcode scanners work, but a warung sells the same twenty things, so typing the price is faster. Change is worked out for you.
Let customers pay by QRIS when they have no cash. The QR carries the exact amount, and the settlement is matched back to that one sale.
Close with a counted drawer. kasir.mu compares it with what should be there, flags the gap as over or short, and the End of Day report prints or exports for your records.

faq.q: What happens when the internet drops?
faq.a: Nothing stops. Every sale, shift event and stock change is written to the device first. While offline they wait in a queue that flows to the cloud in order once the connection returns, and each item is tracked as pending, synced or failed — nothing is lost silently.

faq.q: Do I need a barcode scanner or a special cash register?
faq.a: No. kasir.mu runs on the Windows PC or tablet you already have, and receipt printers are ordinary 58/80mm ESC/POS models. A barcode scanner and an RJ-11 cash drawer work too, if you have them.

faq.q: Can my customers pay with QRIS?
faq.a: Yes, on every plan including Free. Show a dynamic QR with the exact amount, or display your own store's QRIS sticker and record the reference for the receipt.

faq.q: How do I check the day's takings?
faq.a: Close the shift and the End of Day report summarises it: revenue, voids and discounts, payment breakdown, cash reconciliation and sales by hour — printable or exportable.

faq.q: Can two terminals take orders at the same time?
faq.a: Yes. Each terminal keeps its own local database, so neither waits on the other, and they converge as soon as they can reach the cloud.

faq.q: Does a wrong order end up in the books?
faq.a: Only as a void. Voids and refunds are recorded with the user, the terminal and the reason, so the day's report shows what was rung and what was taken back.

faq.q: What if the restaurant's Wi-Fi is unreliable?
faq.a: Orders and payments are written locally first and queue while offline. When the connection returns, the queue syncs in order and the terminals are updated — a dropped connection never blocks a table.

faq.q: Do you support splitting a bill or moving tables?
faq.a: Yes: bills split or merge per guest and can be moved between tables, and the analytics track how many tables each server handles.

features.title: Works offline
features.description: Perform stocktakes, audits, and manifests without internet — zero dropped records during network blackouts.

benefits: Dedicated warehousing mode for fulfillment centers and stock depots.
Full audit trail for every bin adjustment, dispatch, and receipt.
Local SQLite reliability — keep scanning pallets even in steel warehouses with dead zones.
day: Move pallets as recorded transfers: source, destination, quantity and dispatch time, with late transit flagged before a pallet is simply missing.
Reverse the transfer that went to the wrong location and the stock returns to where it came from.
Keep the count honest — every adjustment, whether a restock, a count correction, damage or disposal, writes a ledger entry with who changed it, when and why.
Value what you hold: the Stock Report gives stock, threshold, price, cost, margin and total stock value per product, printable or exportable as CSV.

faq.q: Can the warehouse keep working without internet?
faq.a: Yes. Movements are written to the local database first and queue while offline; when the connection returns they sync in order, each item tracked as pending, synced or failed.

faq.q: How do I see what is stuck in transit?
faq.a: Transfers in transit are audited with source, destination, quantity and dispatch time, and anything overdue is flagged so you can chase it before it becomes a loss.

faq.q: Who is allowed to change stock?
faq.a: Roles decide. Staff can sell but not adjust stock, managers can adjust, transfer and run counts, and an auditor can read inventory and reports without changing anything.

faq.q: Can I get the stock figures out of the app?
faq.a: The Stock Report prints or exports to CSV, with stock, threshold, price, cost, margin and stock value for every product.
